entries.1599fd1e903038dd: Nonwoven fabric made from chemical fibers, using the thermal bond process, in which heat-melting fibers are laid in layers and bonded by heat. entries.353659e13b170262: This business manufactures and sells sanitary paper made mainly from fresh pulp. It is mainly used as wrapping paper for absorbent cores of disposable diapers and pet sheets, hot towels, table napkins and others, and it is sold as an intermediate material.
